cars.notes: All-new second-generation Seltos (launched 2 Jan 2026); GTX(O)/X-Line(O) added July 2026. Prices rose since launch (Rs 10.99 lakh launch base). CarDekho prices ending in 899/901/401 normalised to the nearest Rs 100 (Kia's own trim prices end in 900). The 6-speed turbo iMT from launch no longer appears on Kia's or CarDekho's current lists, so it is omitted. Kia India does not publish ARAI mileage on its site; figures shown were reported by Gaadify (via Vahan Warta) and match Autocar India's 15.6-19.4 kmpl range and its 17.8 kmpl diesel figure. Power: Kia/press quote 115 PS, 160 PS and 116 PS; CarDekho bhp figures used. Wheels for HTE(O) to HTX(A) not reliably confirmed: Kia lists 16-inch styled steel (some MT-only) and 17-inch crystal-cut alloys on mid trims, Rushlane says 17-inch alloys from HTK, CarDekho shows 16-inch steel for HTK and HTX. HTE(O) adds mainly automatic-specific kit (listed as extras on IVT/AT variants). Trim feature lists are from Rushlane's launch variant guide; 'A' trims add ADAS. Update 21 Oct 2026: added front photo (File:Kia Seltos X-line.jpg); no Indian-market rear photo on Commons. Prices re-checked against CarDekho New Delhi (all unchanged) and CarWale (Mumbai ranges consistent; CarWale's HTE start of Rs 11.00 lakh is lower than CarDekho's Rs 11.25 lakh). Mileage unchanged. Spec audit 21 Oct 2026: all engine figures confirmed (diesel 114 bhp/250 Nm per CarDekho and Autocar; petrol rpm figures not restated by sources checked).

front.file: File:2025 Kia Carens Clavis HTX Plus.png

cars.photoNotes: Front: Indian-market Carens Clavis HTX+ in a showroom, near-front three-quarter view; 'Carens' display plate, a person is in the driver's seat and the showroom background is a little busy. Rear: rejected 'File:2025 kia Carens Clavis Facelift 1.5 T-GDi 7DCT (2).jpg' (Indian car, rear three-quarter, but has a media-drive number sticker on the rear window and a temporary plate). 'File:4th International Auto Show, Bangalore (2025) 95.jpg' is a three-quarter front view at a cluttered show stand with a person beside it.
cars.notes: The Carens has been replaced in the main line-up by the Carens Clavis (launched May 2025, updated with HTE(EX) in Jan 2026 and GTX/GTX+/X-Line plus 6-seat options in March 2026); this entry covers the Carens Clavis. CarDekho still lists a separate older 'Kia Carens' at Rs 11.12-12.98 lakh that is not covered here. CarDekho lists 42 variants, Autocar 42 variant rows (its FAQ says 37). Several CarDekho prices look inconsistent and need checking: HTK+ Turbo MT Rs 15,19,790 (Kia's HTK+ starting price is Rs 16,43,900), HTX+ Turbo MT 7-seat Rs 18,68,915 vs 6-seat Rs 19,03,900, HTX+ iMT 7-seat Rs 19,32,900 vs 6-seat Rs 19,12,700. X-Line 6-seat was listed at Rs 17,28,276 (clearly wrong; Autocar shows same on-road price as the 7-seater), so its price is null. Prices ending in 899/901 normalised to nearest Rs 100 (Kia's own figures end in 900). Mileage is ARAI per Autocar India and CarDekho (agree); CNG km/kg not published. Diesel power/torque for the Clavis not confirmed (Autocar quotes 116 hp). Seats: 7, with 6-seat versions on some trims. Wheels per Kia: 15-inch gloss-black alloys on base petrol, 16-inch styled steel with cover for turbo/diesel/CNG on base trims, 17-inch alloys on upper trims; per-trim mapping for HTE(O)/HTE(EX) inferred from Kia's base-trim listing. Trim order follows Autocar's feature ladder (HTX+ adds over HTX(O) A; GTX adds over HTX). Update 21 Oct 2026: added front photo (File:2025 Kia Carens Clavis HTX Plus.png); rear still missing. Prices: HTX+ Turbo MT 7-seat changed from Rs 18,68,915 to Rs 19,03,900 (Kia's HTX+ starting price; CarWale Rs 19.04 lakh; Autocar shows the same Delhi on-road price for 6- and 7-seat); HTX+ Turbo iMT 6-seat changed from Rs 19,12,700 to Rs 19,32,900 (Autocar gives 6- and 7-seat iMT the same on-road price; CarWale 7-seat iMT Rs 19.33 lakh); X-Line 6-seat filled at Rs 21,78,900 (Kia X-Line price; Autocar same on-road price as the 7-seater); HTK+ Turbo MT price set to null because CarDekho's Rs 15,19,790 does not fit Autocar's Rs 17.87 lakh Delhi on-road price (that implies roughly Rs 15.4 lakh ex-showroom), and neither Kia's trim grid nor CarWale lists this version. Other 6-seat versions are Rs 8,000-12,000 cheaper than the 7-seaters on CarDekho, but Autocar shows the same on-road price for both, so this is unconfirmed (CarDekho figures kept). HTX Turbo MT and HTX Turbo iMT appear on CarDekho and Autocar but not in Kia's trim grid or CarWale's list (kept). CNG mileage still null: Autocar's spec page shows 25 km/kg as 'official', but Autocar's launch report says Kia had not declared a certified figure, and CarDekho, CarWale and 91wheels show none. Spec audit 21 Oct 2026: diesel filled from CarDekho (114.41 bhp @ 4000 rpm, 250 Nm @ 1500-2750 rpm, 4 cylinders) and Autocar India (116 hp, 250 Nm): cylinders null -> 4, power null -> 114.4 bhp @ 4000 rpm, torque null -> 250 Nm @ 1500-2750 rpm. Other figures confirmed.

Wheels for Leader Edition (gloss-black, size reported as 18-inch by some outlets), Neo Drive and GR-S are not confirmed. 7 airbags per CarDekho.
